messages.content: You identify patterns in complete email texts. Respond with valid JSON.

Please write a BRIEF 15-20 word executive summary of the theme "Information Provision" as it appears in the following examples.
['You have 1 unread Message!', 'ALL THE ORIGINAL CONTRACTORS HAS JUST RECEIVED THEIR FINAL PHASE OF THEIR PAYMENT LEAVING A TOTAL SUM OF $30 MILLION USD FLOATING IN THE FILES OF FEDERAL MINISTRY OF FINANCE UNCLAIMED', 'On the 11th October 2004 our late father attended the general meeting of all the import/export companies in the country, and unfortunately he was poisoned by his business rivals, and he later died in the hospital.', 'Now, a new Financial Law, which takes effect in two months time, stipulates that any bank account more than $5,000,000.00 [Five Million US Dollars] will be investigated, and the bank shall produce the account owner for clearance.', "We're introducing our new online banking to all customers in early 2012.", 'Unfortunately there has been a problem processing your last transfer information for the month of August 2007.', 'Your Account Will Be Limited, Until We Here From You.', 'We regret to inform you that your Apple ID has been locked for security reasons.', 'Your access to Online Banking Service has been suspended.', 'World of Warcraft: Cataclysm Beta Test Invitation!', 'You have exceeded your email storage capacity.', "Until we can confirm the information you've given us, we need to limit most of the functionality on your account.", 'Our system has blocked this sign in attempt as a security measure.', 'Your Wachovia account has been selected for a free premium service upgrade at your choice, for further information please...', 'Your Abbey Bank account has been limited!', 'We would like to notify you that NatWest bank carries out customer data verification procedure that is compulsory for all NatWest bank customers.', 'our monitoring process has temporarily suspended your online access.', 'We have implemented security measures consistent with our internal information security practices helping us keep your information secure.', 'Your incoming mail are blocked.']

DO NOT write the summary as a third party using terms like "the text examples" or "they discuss", but write the summary from the perspective of the text authors making the points directly.
Please respond ONLY with a valid JSON in the following format:
{
    "summary": "<SUMMARY>"
}

content: {"summary": "We provide account, service, and security updates, including payment and policy information, while requesting verification or warning of access limits and disruptions."}
